import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
base = Path('build/jit-prepared-activations')
frozen = json.loads((base / 'v3-frozen-candidate-inputs.json').read_text())
def verify():
    for path, digest in frozen.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, path
verify()
early = json.loads((base / 'v2-early-paired3.json').read_text())
assert early['status'] == 'passed'
for name, gain in [('stack', .20), ('queue', .20), ('dsu', .15)]:
    x = early['summary'][name]
    assert x['after']['median_ms'] / x['before']['median_ms'] <= 1 - gain, name

commands = []
def run(command, suffix, env=None):
    verify()
    print('Starting', suffix, flush=True)
    commands.append({'suffix': suffix, 'command': command, 'environment_overrides': env or {}})
    (base / 'v3-validation-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands, indent=2) + '\n')
    with Path('/tmp/mmay-jit-prepared-v3-' + suffix + '.log').open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run((['env'] + [k + '=' + v for k, v in env.items()] if env else []) + command,
                       stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    print('Passed', suffix, flush=True)

def tests(build, suffix, count, pattern=None, env=None):
    command = ['ctest', '--test-dir', build, '--output-on-failure', '-j2']
    if pattern: command += ['-R', pattern]
    run(command, suffix + '-tests', env)
    assert re.search(r'100% tests passed(?:, 0 tests failed)? out of ' + str(count) + r'\b',
                     Path('/tmp/mmay-jit-prepared-v3-' + suffix + '-tests.log').read_text())

def configure(build, suffix, options):
    run(['cmake', '-S', '.', '-B', build] + options, suffix + '-configure')

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / 'build/jit-prepared-activations'
control = root / 'build/jit-ref-array-off'
candidate = root / 'build/jit-prepared-activations-off'
out = base / 'off-identity'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
config = Path('generated/mmay/build_config.h')
old = (control / config).read_text()
new = (candidate / config).read_text()
assert new.replace(str(candidate), str(control)) == old
commands = []
def run(command):
    commands.append(command)
    subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)

same, different, added = {}, {}, {}
for path in candidate.glob('CMakeFiles/**/*.c.o'):
    relative = path.relative_to(candidate)
    previous = control / relative
    if not previous.exists(): added[str(relative)] = sha(path)
    elif sha(path) == sha(previous): same[str(relative)] = sha(path)
    else: different[str(relative)] = {'before': sha(previous), 'after': sha(path)}
expected = ['bootstrap/src/native/runtime_artifact.c', 'bootstrap/src/cli/cli_doctor.c']
assert set(different) == {'CMakeFiles/mmay_bootstrap.dir/' + p + '.o' for p in expected}
assert set(added) == {'CMakeFiles/mmay_bootstrap.dir/bootstrap/src/bytecode/vm_frame_layout.c.o'}
flags = {}
for line in (candidate / 'CMakeFiles/mmay_bootstrap.dir/flags.make').read_text().splitlines():
    if ' = ' in line:
        key, value = line.split(' = ', 1)
        flags[key] = shlex.split(value)
includes = [arg.replace(str(candidate / 'generated'), str(control / 'generated')) for arg in flags['C_INCLUDES']]
replacement_objects = []
for source in expected:
    obj = out / (Path(source).name + '.o')
    command = ['/usr/bin/cc'] + flags['C_DEFINES'] + includes + flags['C_FLAGS'] + ['-c', str(root / source), '-o', str(obj)]
    run(command)
    previous = control / ('CMakeFiles/mmay_bootstrap.dir/' + source + '.o')
    assert sha(obj) == sha(previous), source
    replacement_objects.append(str(obj))
archive = out / 'libmmay_bootstrap.a'
shutil.copy2(candidate / archive.name, archive)
run(['/usr/bin/ar', '-r', str(archive)] + replacement_objects)
link = shlex.split((candidate / 'CMakeFiles/mmay.dir/link.txt').read_text())
link[link.index('-o') + 1] = str(out / 'mmay')
link = [str(archive) if word == 'libmmay_bootstrap.a' else
    str(candidate / word) if word.startswith('CMakeFiles/') else word for word in link]
run(link)
def normalized_macho(path):
    data = bytearray(Path(path).read_bytes())
    assert struct.unpack_from('<I', data)[0] == 0xfeedfacf
    position = 32
    excluded = []
    for _ in range(struct.unpack_from('<I', data, 16)[0]):
        command, size = struct.unpack_from('<II', data, position)
        if command == 0x1b:
            excluded.append({'offset': position + 8, 'bytes': 16, 'kind': 'LC_UUID'})
        if command == 0x1d:
            offset, length = struct.unpack_from('<II', data, position + 8)
            excluded.append({'offset': offset, 'bytes': length, 'kind': 'LC_CODE_SIGNATURE payload'})
        position += size
    assert len(excluded) == 2
    for region in excluded:
        data[region['offset']:region['offset'] + region['bytes']] = bytes(region['bytes'])
    return data, excluded

normalized, regions = normalized_macho(out / 'mmay')
previous, previous_regions = normalized_macho(control / 'mmay')
assert regions == previous_regions and normalized == previous
result = {'status': 'passed', 'scope': 'All OFF compiler objects are identical except two objects containing build-directory constants. Recompiling those current sources with only the control generated build_config.h yields identical objects. Replacing them in a copy of the candidate archive and linking yields the accepted executable apart from the linker UUID and its dependent ad-hoc signature. Actual candidate build paths remain unchanged.',
    'actual_candidate_sha256': sha(candidate / 'mmay'), 'control_sha256': sha(control / 'mmay'),
    'canonicalized_candidate_sha256': sha(out / 'mmay'), 'identical_objects': same,
    'normalized_executable_sha256': hashlib.sha256(normalized).hexdigest(),
    'excluded_nonexecution_metadata': regions,
    'different_build_path_objects': different, 'added_unlinked_object': added,
    'candidate_build_config': new, 'control_build_config': old,
    'commands': commands, 'limitation': 'Actual OFF executable hashes differ by build-location metadata; this is a canonical-build identity proof, not a new OFF performance measurement.'}
(base / 'v3-off-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print('OFF canonical executable identity proven:', result['normalized_executable_sha256'], 'identical objects:', len(same))

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

base = Path('build/jit-prepared-activations/concurrency-check')
base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assert not (base / 'protocol.json').exists(), 'Do not overwrite a completed or running experiment'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
now = lambda: datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
control = 'build/jit-ref-array-off/mmay'
candidate = 'build/jit-prepared-activations-off/mmay'
frozen = json.loads(Path('build/jit-prepared-activations/v2-frozen-candidate-inputs.json').read_text())
assert all(sha(p) == v for p, v in frozen.items())
workloads = ['normalize-title', 'catalog-dotcall', 'stack', 'queue', 'unique-set']
protocol = {
    'started_utc': now(), 'previous_turn': 'progress: concurrency evidence changed the next action',
    'purpose': 'Diagnose the five OFF regressions against an unchanged-binary negative control before attributing them to source changes.',
    'control': {'path': control, 'sha256': sha(control)},
    'candidate': {'path': candidate, 'sha256': sha(candidate)},
    'workloads': workloads, 'warmups': 3, 'samples': 11,
    'decision': 'Exactly one A/A series. If every absolute median change is <= 2% and P90 change <= 5%, and the host monitor passes, run exactly one A/B diagnostic series. Otherwise stop as inconclusive; do not retry until passing. No result overrides the prior rejected full32 gate or establishes parity.',
    'environment': 'AC power at every 5-second observation, no positive thermal warning, no observed foreign compiler/test process, no two consecutive observations of aggregate background process CPU above 150% (one core = 100%). ps CPU is a heuristic, not proof of host isolation. Record all observations.',
    'inputs_sha256': frozen,
}
(base / 'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol, indent=2) + '\n')

def snapshot():
    rows = []
    for line in subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-Ao', 'pid,ppid,pcpu,comm'], text=True).splitlines()[1:]:
        p, parent, cpu, command = line.strip().split(None, 3)
        rows.append({'pid': int(p), 'ppid': int(parent), 'cpu': float(cpu), 'command': command})
    own = {os.getpid()}
    for _ in rows:
        more = {r['pid'] for r in rows if r['ppid'] in own}
        if more <= own: break
        own |= more
    background = [r for r in rows if r['pid'] not in own]
    foreign = [r for r in background if Path(r['command']).name in {'cc', 'clang', 'clang-17', 'clang-21', 'ld', 'make', 'ninja', 'ctest', 'rustc', 'cargo', 'go', 'mmay_c_unit', 'mmay'}]
    power = subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'batt'], text=True)
    thermal = subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'therm'], text=True)
    return {'at_utc': now(), 'background_cpu_sum': sum(r['cpu'] for r in background),
        'foreign_build_test_processes': foreign, 'top_background': sorted(background, key=lambda r: -r['cpu'])[:15],
        'power': power, 'thermal': thermal,
        'power_ok': "Now drawing from 'AC Power'" in power,
        'thermal_ok': 'No thermal warning level has been recorded' in thermal and 'No performance warning level has been recorded' in thermal}

def run(label, after):
    path = base / (label + '.json')
    command = ['python3', 'tools/performance/compare-vm-preparation.py', '--benchmarks', '../algorithm-benchmarks',
        '--reference', 'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json',
        '--before', control, '--after', after, '--output', str(path)]
    for name in workloads: command += ['--workload', name]
    (base / (label + '-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2) + '\n')
    observations = [snapshot()]
    print('Starting', label, flush=True)
    with (base / (label + '.log')).open('w') as log, (base / (label + '-monitor.jsonl')).open('w') as monitor:
        monitor.write(json.dumps(observations[0]) + '\n'); monitor.flush()
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        while child.poll() is None:
            try: child.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: pass
            observations.append(snapshot())
            monitor.write(json.dumps(observations[-1]) + '\n'); monitor.flush()
        if child.returncode: raise RuntimeError(f'{label} exited {child.returncode}')
    assert all(sha(p) == v for p, v in frozen.items())
    data = json.loads(path.read_text())
    ratios = {n: {'median': r['after']['median_ms'] / r['before']['median_ms'],
        'p90': sorted(data['raw_ms'][n]['after'])[9] / sorted(data['raw_ms'][n]['before'])[9]} for n, r in data['summary'].items()}
    host_ok = all(x['power_ok'] and x['thermal_ok'] and not x['foreign_build_test_processes'] for x in observations)
    host_ok &= not any(a['background_cpu_sum'] > 150 and b['background_cpu_sum'] > 150 for a,b in zip(observations, observations[1:]))
    result = {'host_monitor_passed': host_ok, 'observations': len(observations), 'ratios': ratios}
    print(label, json.dumps(result), flush=True)
    return result

outcome = {'aa': run('aa', control)}
aa = outcome['aa']
aa_ok = aa['host_monitor_passed'] and all(abs(x['median']-1) <= .02 and abs(x['p90']-1) <= .05 for x in aa['ratios'].values())
if aa_ok:
    outcome['ab'] = run('ab', candidate)
    outcome['status'] = 'diagnostic-complete' if outcome['ab']['host_monitor_passed'] else 'inconclusive-host-activity'
else:
    outcome['status'] = 'inconclusive-negative-control'
outcome['finished_utc'] = now()
(base / 'outcome.json').write_text(json.dumps(outcome, indent=2) + '\n')
print(outcome['status'], flush=True)

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root = Path.cwd()
base = root / 'build/jit-prepared-activations'
frozen = json.loads((base / 'v3-frozen-candidate-inputs.json').read_text())
for name, digest in frozen.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
proof = json.loads((base / 'v3-off-identity.json').read_text())
assert proof['status'] == 'passed'
assert hashlib.sha256((base / 'mmay').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == hashlib.sha256((base / 'v2-preserved/on/mmay').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
confirmations = json.loads((base / 'confirmation-outcomes.json').read_text())
assert all(not c['confirmed_regressions'] for c in confirmations['jit'].values())
compiler = base / 'mmay'
digest = hashlib.sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
bench = root.parent / 'algorithm-benchmarks'
output = base / 'v3-comprehensive-current.md'
command = ['python3', str(bench / 'benchmarks/catalog_bench.py'), '--anchors', '--profile', 'standard',
           '--warmups', '3', '--samples', '11', '--output', str(output)]
record = {'command': command, 'cwd': str(bench), 'environment_overrides': {'MMAY': str(compiler)},
          'compiler_sha256': digest}
(base / 'v3-comprehensive-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
with (base / 'v3-comprehensive-current.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(command, cwd=bench, env=dict(os.environ, MMAY=str(compiler)),
                   stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
result = json.loads(output.with_suffix('.json').read_text())
assert result['status'] == 'passed' and len(result['workloads']) == 32
assert result['metadata']['artifacts']['mmay_compiler']['sha256'] == digest
reference = json.loads((root / 'docs/implementation/evidence/cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json').read_text())
assert result['metadata']['source_sha256'] == reference['metadata']['source_sha256']
for name, checksum in frozen.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == checksum, name
print('Fresh five-participant, 32-workload comparison passed.', flush=True)

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

base = Path('build/jit-prepared-activations')
dest = Path('docs/implementation/evidence')
stem = 'cp42-sljit-prepared-isolation'
date = '2026-09-11'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text())
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
validation_path = dest / f'{stem}-validation-{date}.json'
validation = read(validation_path)
result = read(base / 'v3-comprehensive-current.json')
command = read(base / 'v3-comprehensive-command.json')
reference = read(dest / 'cp42-vm-preparation-comprehensive-2026-09-09.json')
participants = ['marimay-native', 'go', 'rust', 'marimay-vm', 'bun']
assert result['status'] == 'passed' and len(result['workloads']) == 32
assert result['metadata']['participants'] == participants
assert result['metadata']['warmups'] == 3 and result['metadata']['samples'] == 11
assert len(result['metadata']['source_sha256']) == 114
assert result['metadata']['source_sha256'] == reference['metadata']['source_sha256']
compiler_sha = sha(base / 'mmay')
assert compiler_sha == command['compiler_sha256']
assert compiler_sha == result['metadata']['artifacts']['mmay_compiler']['sha256']
assert compiler_sha == validation['configurations']['arm64-release']['compiler_sha256']
for name, digest in validation['inputs_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(Path(name)) == digest, name
for workload in result['workloads'].values():
    assert set(workload['summary']) == set(participants)
    assert all(workload['outcomes'][p]['status'] == 'passed' for p in participants)
    assert all(len(workload['raw_ms'][p]) == 11 for p in participants)
files = {}
for suffix in ['json', 'md']:
    name = f'{stem}-comprehensive-{date}.{suffix}'
    (dest / name).write_bytes((base / f'v3-comprehensive-current.{suffix}').read_bytes())
    files[suffix] = {'file': name, 'sha256': sha(dest / name)}
ratios = {}
for marimay in ['marimay-native', 'marimay-vm']:
    ratios[marimay] = {}
    for other in ['go', 'rust', 'bun']:
        values = [w['summary'][marimay]['median_ms'] / w['summary'][other]['median_ms']
                  for w in result['workloads'].values()]
        ratios[marimay][other] = {
            'geometric_mean_time_ratio': math.exp(sum(map(math.log, values)) / len(values)),
            'workloads_no_slower': sum(v <= 1 for v in values),
        }
validation['comprehensive'] = {
    'recorded_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'files': files,
    'reproduction': command,
    'compiler_sha256': compiler_sha,
    'participants': participants,
    'source_hash_count': 114,
    'host_monitor': [json.loads(line) for line in (base / 'v3-fiveway-host-monitor.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
    'scripts': {p: (base / p).read_text() for p in ['compare-all-v3.py', 'attach-comprehensive-v3.py', 'measure-fiveway-v3.py']},
    'summary': ratios,
    'interpretation': 'Descriptive equal-workload geometric means from one fresh five-participant series, not the paired acceptance gate. VM includes source preparation. Native emission/runtime were not changed by this stage. Host isolation is unverified; per-participant dispersion and noise flags remain in the unchanged harness report.',
}
validation_path.write_text(json.dumps(validation, indent=2) + '\n')
report_path = dest / f'{stem}-{date}.md'
report = report_path.read_text()
marker = '\n## Fresh five-participant comparison\n'
assert marker not in report
native, vm = ratios['marimay-native'], ratios['marimay-vm']
addition = marker + f'\nThe same candidate executable (SHA-256 `{compiler_sha}`) completed a new '
addition += f'[32-workload five-participant series]({files["md"]["file"]}) '
addition += f'([raw observations and executable/input hashes]({files["json"]["file"]})). '
addition += 'All 160 participant/workload correctness outcomes passed, using 3 warmups and 11 samples, unchanged 114 input hashes and the 64 MiB managed heap limit. All five columns come from this one series.\n\n'
addition += f'Descriptive geometric means of time ratios across the 32 workloads are native/Go **{native["go"]["geometric_mean_time_ratio"]:.2f}×**, native/Rust **{native["rust"]["geometric_mean_time_ratio"]:.2f}×**, VM/Go **{vm["go"]["geometric_mean_time_ratio"]:.2f}×**, and VM/Rust **{vm["rust"]["geometric_mean_time_ratio"]:.2f}×**. '
addition += f'Native is no slower than Go on {native["go"]["workloads_no_slower"]}/32 median observations and Rust on {native["rust"]["workloads_no_slower"]}/32. These descriptive ratios do not replace the paired acceptance matrix or establish overall parity. Native generation/runtime are unchanged by this JIT stage.\n\n'
addition += 'VM includes loading, checking and lowering source; Bun includes process startup, TypeScript loading and JIT. Native compilation is excluded. Host isolation is unverified. The full report retains per-participant dispersion, noise flags and every raw observation without a replacement run.\n'
report_path.write_text(report.replace('\n## Limits of this evidence\n', addition + '\n## Limits of this evidence\n'))
print(json.dumps({'status': result['status'], 'files': files, 'ratios': ratios}, indent=2))

import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

base = Path('build/jit-prepared-activations')
assert not (base / 'v3-comprehensive-current.json').exists(), 'Preserve the previous series'
record = base / 'v3-fiveway-host-monitor.jsonl'
assert not record.exists()
with record.open('w') as output:
    child = subprocess.Popen(['caffeinate', '-i', 'python3', str(base / 'compare-all-v3.py')])
    while True:
        output.write(json.dumps({'utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            'power': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'batt'], text=True),
            'thermal': subprocess.check_output(['pmset', '-g', 'therm'], text=True),
            'processes': subprocess.check_output(['ps', '-Ao', 'pid,ppid,pcpu,comm', '-r'], text=True).splitlines()[:26]}) + '\n')
        output.flush()
        try:
            child.wait(timeout=10)
            break
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            pass
    if child.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Comparison failed: ' + str(child.returncode))
print('Five-participant series and host monitor completed.', flush=True)
